method: Exact redesigned file individually inspected at full rendered frame. Five equal-weight editorial dimensions, >=85 overall and >=75 each, plus no visible watermark/text hard gate. Experimental spatial ontology is intentional; this is environment key art, not a certified playable level.
name: The Lacuna Stair
observations: All four corners are free of a visible floating mark, signature, logo or generated lettering.
A lateral view from an empty balcony and a single small mid-distance surveyor improve the camera diversity of the dungeon series.
Wet grey limestone, large empty shadow regions, one amber lamp and the ordinary mountain doorway create disciplined adult quiet dread.
Visible stair treads, joints and drooping cord anchor the local spatial anomaly in ordinary material craft.
defectsOrLimits: The image does not demonstrate a complete continuous closed floor-to-ceiling loop; the ceiling continuation is deliberately discontinuous/ambiguous.
The ordinary right-hand doorway reads very large relative to the distant surveyor because of perspective; it supplies the mundane/exterior boundary, not an exact ruler.
A later authored traversal and gravity-transition diagram is required before the experimental concept becomes playable.
